start.title: [TODO:ru] Three Graves in Moab
start.text:
[TODO:ru] Naomi has lost her husband and sons.
Grief settles like dusk.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Sit in silence beside her grief
[TODO:ru] Leave her to mourn alone
[TODO:ru] Tell her to forget the dead

alone_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Return to Her
alone_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] She is your mother by love.
Go back and sit with her.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Sit in silence beside her grief
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] She leans her head to yours.

forget_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Honor Her Loss
forget_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Grief is not a stain to wipe.
Let her weep beside you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Sit in silence beside her grief
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You bow your head with hers.

road_decision.title: [TODO:ru] She Tells You to Go Home
road_decision.text:
[TODO:ru] "Return to your people," she pleads.
The road forks before you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Turn back to Moab and your gods
[TODO:ru] Wait for another to decide for you
[TODO:ru] "Where you go, I will go."

turnback_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Loyalty Calls You
turnback_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Comfort lies behind, but love walks ahead.
Go with Naomi.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "Where you go, I will go."

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Choose for Yourself
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] No one can carry your vow but you.
Speak it now.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "Where you go, I will go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The words rise from your heart.

bethlehem_arrival.title: [TODO:ru] Bethlehem at Dawn
bethlehem_arrival.text:
[TODO:ru] Naomi returns home empty-handed.
The village whispers around you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Hide your Moabite roots in shame
[TODO:ru] Beg in the street for bread
[TODO:ru] Offer to glean grain to feed her

hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Your love for Naomi is not a stain.
Lift your head and serve.

beg_consequence.text:

barley_field.title: [TODO:ru] Among the Reapers
barley_field.text:
[TODO:ru] Boaz, kind and strong, sees you working.
"Stay in my fields," he says.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Refuse his kindness in pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Grace is meant to be received.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bow and thank him with humility
[TODO:ru] Demand more than he offers

refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Pride leaves you with empty hands.
Accept the gift before you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bow and thank him with humility

demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] His mercy is not yours to seize.
Receive it gently.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bow and thank him with humility

threshing_floor.text:
[TODO:ru] "Go to the threshing floor," she says.
"Ask Boaz to be your redeemer."

[TODO:ru] Ignore her wisdom and stay home
[TODO:ru] Seek a wealthier man instead
